train: run the main training loop for a language model with checkpointing, evaluation, and early stopping
train_1: train the model for a single iteration with optional gradient accumulation across sub-batches
create_train_feed: create a training feed dictionary with model inputs, dropout, learning rate, and state masking
summarize_checkpoint: summarize loading a TensorFlow checkpoint with fallback for missing keys and old formats
review_batch_split: review splitting a batch into accumulation sub-batches and concatenating hidden states
